correctness.rationale: Finite-field invertibility proves pairwise independence; exhaustive classification of the first q coordinates gives the exact overshoot mean; direct algebra yields a positive gap for every prime q >= 11 and an asymptotic ratio 9/8.

originality.rationale: Inspected Lorden and later overshoot/dependent-renewal literature did not reveal a pairwise-independence counterexample or the explicit finite-field family and gap formula. Closest modern dependent extensions impose additional structural conditions.

value.rationale: The result gives a concrete obstruction to weakening mutual independence in a standard first-passage bound, even for bounded positive two-point marginals, and quantifies a nonvanishing asymptotic violation.
